_about: Operational Site Signal rules and English UI labels (WS4, task D11). Frozen with docs/11-site-signal-sap.md and monitoring/params.yaml by the sap-v1 tag; after the tag any change needs a row in docs/11 section 17. Read by backend/app/services/episodes.py, site_signal.py and site_queries.py and by monitoring/, with no LLM on this path. Schema: docs/02-data-model.md, Files behind Site Signal. Values: docs/11 sections 4 to 8. Grades come only from rules.py and data/ctcae_rules.json. term_synonyms is our own lower-case list (no MedDRA codes or hierarchy). Tier thresholds are not in this file; they come from monitoring/out/thresholds.json. A tier marks capture discordance: a reason to look, not a finding.

none.en: No signal at this sample size

footer.en: A reason to look, not a finding.

footer_expected_false_look.en: About {expected_false_look} false Look flags are expected in a study like this with no problems, under the pre-registered null.

error.en: The analysis could not be completed for this site's data, so no tier is shown.

integrated_mode.en: Between Visits drafts reached this site's staff during the analysis window, so its AE log is not independent of the patient reports and the site is not compared.

low_coverage.en: Fewer than 60% of scheduled calls were completed at this site, too few to compare its AE log with the patient reports.

insufficient_patients.en: This site has fewer than 10 patients, too few for a site-level comparison.

insufficient_episodes.en: This site has fewer than 15 evaluable episodes outside the paged stratum, or no variation to measure, so a site-level comparison is not possible.

study_below_min_sites.en: Fewer than 10 sites in this study have enough data for a comparison, so no site is ranked.

language_gap.en: Planted: lower capture for Spanish speakers
